title: Snipe buy minOut fails open: when the quote fails the buy is still sent with amountOutMin = 0

evidence.note: V2: let minOut = 0n; try { getAmountsOut ... } catch { warn "defaulting to 0" } — then the swap is built with that minOut (:1104-1109)
V3: same pattern on quoteExactInputSingle; amountOutMinimum: minOut (:1390)
minOut = expectedOut - expectedOut * BigInt(slippage) / 100n: BigInt() of a fractional percent throws RangeError, which the same catch turns into minOut = 0
slippagePercent is hard-coded 5, so the fractional crash is latent today; CONFIG.slippagePercent || 5 at bot.ts:1050/:1373 also makes 0 impossible
sibling in the same file already fails CLOSED: the deliberate public leg returns null on a quote failure
codex (22-27 independent second opinion, graded S1): Quote or slippage-conversion failures turn into unrestricted buys
codex (22-27 independent second opinion, graded S1): A configured zero-slippage limit becomes five percent

sibling_sites_checked: V2 snipe (bot.ts:1048-1056) and V3 snipe (:1362-1377) both fail open. Deliberate private leg (:527-543) also defaults privMinOut to 0 on a quote failure; that is documented intent (comment :533-538: private, un-sandwichable routing) and is recorded here as a sibling for card OD-15, not as a separate defect. Deliberate public leg (:711-729) fails closed (correct). tokenSafety simulateSwap/simulateSwapForChain use amountOutMin 0 only inside .staticCall (simulation, no money). Exit-side minOut belongs to the EXIT slice (RC-03).
severity_rationale: S1, equal to the research suggestion. The code alone proves the fail-open: on any quote error minOut stays 0n and the buy proceeds. Plausible condition: one RPC error or a quoter revert during a launch block. The private routing prevents a sandwich but not buying at the top of a launch block behind other snipers, so the loss is bounded by the snipe amount, not prevented.
recommendation: Decide on card OD-15 whether a snipe whose quote fails is skipped (fail closed) or sent unprotected. Separately keep the slippage math in bigint basis points so a fractional percent can never throw into the fail-open catch. Phase 24, after a Phase 23 proof; nothing is changed in Phase 22.
